先行词（抽象地点名词：point, case, situation, stage 等）+ where + 完整从句
先行词 + 介词（in/at/on）+ which + 完整从句（相当于 where，更正式）
such + where + 完整从句（正式/书面语，相当于 such a place where）
the place where / a place where / the venue where + 完整从句
notes: 高考中常考抽象地点名词（如 point, case, situation, stage）后用 where 引导定语从句，表示“在……的地步、情况、阶段”，此时不能改用 which/that。
书面语或正式语体中，where 常可改写为 in/at/on which，但介词的选择必须符合先行词的搭配或语境。
such where 是较正式的文学性表达，高考作文中如使用需确保语域一致，不宜与口语化句子混用。
注意区分定语从句和地点状语从句：定语从句前必须有被修饰的名词，状语从句前是动词或整个主句。
先行词虽为地点名词，但若在从句中作宾语或主语，必须用 which/that，不能用 where。

examples.en: This is the park where we play football.
examples.cn: 这就是我们踢足球的公园。

examples.en: Do you know a restaurant where we can eat after the match?
examples.cn: 你知道比赛后可以吃饭的餐馆吗？

examples.en: She wants to find a quiet place where she can study without being disturbed.
examples.cn: 她想找一个安静的地方，在那里学习不会被打扰。

examples.en: The venue where all ages can find something to do is worth booking.
examples.cn: 各个年龄都能找到事做的场地值得预订。

examples.en: The situation where a student feels too anxious to speak in class is more common than we think.
examples.cn: 学生在课堂上因过于焦虑而不敢发言的情况比我们想象的更普遍。

examples.en: A city where infrastructure is concentrated downtown leaves the outskirts as a place that policy visits only on paper.
examples.cn: 基础设施集中在市中心的城市，会把郊区变成政策只在纸上光顾的地方。

exercises.q: This is the park ______ we often play football.
exercises.explain: 先行词 park 是地点，从句中缺地点状语，用 where。

exercises.q: This is the library ______ I often read books.
exercises.explain: library 是地点，从句缺地点状语，填 where。

exercises.q: This is the room where I sleep every night.
exercises.explain: room 是地点，sleep 是不及物动词，where 在从句中作地点状语，句子正确。

exercises.q: This is the school. I study in this school. (用 where 合并句子)
exercises.answer: This is the school where I study.
exercises.explain: 用 where 代替 in this school，引导定语从句修饰 school。

exercises.q: This is the school which I study.
exercises.answer: This is the school where I study.
exercises.explain: study 在此是不及物动词，school 在从句中作地点状语，应用 where。

exercises.q: I like the restaurant ______ my father works.
exercises.explain: restaurant 是地点，从句中 work 是不及物动词，缺地点状语，用 where。

exercises.q: The school ______ I study is very big.
exercises.explain: study 在此表示“学习”，school 是地点，从句缺地点状语，用 where。

exercises.q: This is the house ______ my uncle lives.
exercises.explain: live 是不及物动词，house 是地点，从句缺地点状语，用 where。

exercises.q: Do you know a place ______ we can buy some fruit?
exercises.explain: place 是地点，从句中缺地点状语，用 where 引导定语从句。

exercises.q: This is the school ____ I study.
exercises.explain: 学校是地点，从句 I study 完整，用 where。

exercises.q: The park ____ has a trampoline is near my home.
exercises.explain: park 在从句中作主语，用 which，不用 where。

exercises.q: I like the shop ____ we buy bread.
exercises.explain: shop 作地点状语，用 where。

exercises.q: Sunday is the day ____ we visit Grandma.
exercises.explain: day 是时间，用 when。

exercises.q: The reason ____ he was late was the rain.
exercises.explain: the reason 后常用 why。

exercises.q: That is the shop ______ my mother buys vegetables.
exercises.explain: shop 是地点，从句缺地点状语，填 where。

exercises.q: I want to visit the city ______ my grandparents live.
exercises.explain: city 是地点，live 是不及物动词，从句缺地点状语，填 where。

exercises.q: This is the book where I bought yesterday.
exercises.explain: book 不是地点，且 bought 后缺宾语，不能用 where，应用 which/that。

exercises.q: That is the park. We play in the park. (用 where 合并句子)
exercises.answer: That is the park where we play.
exercises.explain: 用 where 代替 in the park，引导定语从句修饰 park。

exercises.q: The village ______ my father grew up is very quiet.
exercises.explain: village 是地点，grow up 是不及物动词短语，从句缺地点状语，用 where。

exercises.q: The hotel ______ we stayed last summer was near the sea.
exercises.explain: hotel 是地点，stay 是不及物动词，从句缺地点状语，填 where。

exercises.q: This is the cinema where we saw the film last night.
exercises.explain: cinema 是地点，从句缺地点状语，where 使用正确。

exercises.q: This is the hospital. My mother works in the hospital. (用 where 合并句子)
exercises.answer: This is the hospital where my mother works.
exercises.explain: 用 where 代替 in the hospital，引导定语从句修饰 hospital。

exercises.q: The house which my grandparents live is very old.
exercises.answer: The house where my grandparents live is very old.
exercises.explain: live 是不及物动词，house 在从句中作地点状语，应用 where。

exercises.q: This is the office ______ Mr. Li works.
exercises.explain: office 是地点，work 是不及物动词，从句缺地点状语，用 where。

exercises.q: I will never forget the day ______ we first met.
exercises.explain: day 是时间，从句缺时间状语，用 when，不能用 where。

exercises.q: The museum ______ we visited last week is very famous.
exercises.explain: museum 在从句中作 visited 的宾语，不是地点状语，用 which。

exercises.q: This is the town ______ my best friend was born.

grammar.title: 情态动词 + 被动语态：can/must/should/may/could/might + be + 过去分词
grammar.titleEn: Modal + passive: must/can/should/may/could be + past participle
grammar.usage:
含情态动词的被动语态用于表达“某事可以被做、必须被做、应该被做”等含义，同时将注意力放在动作的承受者上，而不是执行者。其核心结构为：情态动词 + be + 过去分词。其中 be 永远保持原形，不受主语人称和数的影响；过去分词由主要动词变化而来。

肯定句结构为“主语 + 情态动词 + be + 过去分词（+ by 短语）”，例如：The door must be locked at night. 否定句在情态动词后加 not，结构为“主语 + 情态动词 + not + be + 过去分词”，例如：Personal information should not be shared online. 疑问句将情态动词提至主语前，结构为“情态动词 + 主语 + be + 过去分词？”，例如：Can this machine be repaired? 回答时用“Yes, 主语 + 情态动词”或“No, 主语 + 情态动词 + not”。

与一般现在时被动语态（am/is/are + 过去分词）和一般过去时被动语态（was/were + 过去分词）不同，含情态动词的被动语态不直接表明动作发生的时间，而是表达说话人对动作的态度、判断或推测。例如“The work is done”表示工作已经完成这一事实，而“The work must be done”表示说话人认为工作必须被完成，带有强烈的主观色彩。

初中阶段主要要求掌握 can、must、should 三个情态动词的被动语态，且多用于规则、指令、要求等语境。高中阶段则进一步拓展到 may、might、could、ought to、have to、need 等情态动词的被动形式，并涉及“情态动词 + have been + 过去分词”表示对过去情况的推测或评价，例如：The letter may have been sent to the wrong address. 此外，高中还要求理解含情态动词被动语态在书面语、科技文、新闻、学术写作中的高频使用，以及它与形式主语 it 结构的转换关系。

易错点一：情态动词后漏掉 be，直接写过去分词，如“The work must done”是错误的，正确为“The work must be done”。易错点二：把 be 误写成 is/am/are/was/were，如“The rules can are changed”是错误的，情态动词后必须用动词原形 be。易错点三：否定形式中 not 的位置错误，not 应紧跟在情态动词之后，而不是 be 之后，如“The task should be not delayed”应改为“The task should not be delayed”。易错点四：混淆“情态动词 + be + 过去分词”与“情态动词 + have been + 过去分词”，前者针对现在或将来，后者针对过去，两者时间指向完全不同。
forms: 肯定式：主语 + 情态动词 + be + 过去分词（+ by + 执行者）
否定式：主语 + 情态动词 + not + be + 过去分词
一般疑问式：情态动词 + 主语 + be + 过去分词？
特殊疑问式：疑问词 + 情态动词 + 主语 + be + 过去分词？
过去推测式：主语 + 情态动词 + have been + 过去分词
there be 被动式：there + 情态动词 + be + 过去分词
notes: 情态动词后的 be 永远用原形，不能写成 is/am/are/was/were，这是高考语法填空和短文改错的高频考点。
否定词 not 必须放在情态动词之后、be 之前，书面语中尤其要注意语序，不能写成 be not done。
may/might/could + have been + 过去分词 表示对过去情况的不确定推测，与 must have been done（肯定推测）和 can't have been done（否定推测）构成高考完形和阅读中的常见语义辨析点。
在科技文、新闻报道和学术写作中，含情态动词的被动语态常用来表达客观、严谨的立场，避免直接提及执行者，写作时可有意使用以提升语域。
ought to 和 have to 的被动语态分别为 ought to be done 和 have/has to be done，注意 ought to 的否定形式为 ought not to be done，to 不可省略。

exercises.q: Phones ____ during the test.
exercises.explain: 规定：must be + turned off。

exercises.q: The map ____ by everyone before we leave.
exercises.explain: 建议：should be checked。

exercises.q: Water ____ onto the trampoline.
exercises.explain: 禁止：cannot be taken。

exercises.q: Which is a suggestion, not a rule?
options: Hats should be worn in the sun.
exercises.answer: Hats should be worn in the sun.
exercises.explain: should 表建议，must 表规定。

exercises.q: The photos ____ on the wall.
exercises.explain: hang 的过去分词 hung。

exercises.q: The message can ______ sent by phone.
exercises.explain: can be sent 是含情态动词的被动语态。

exercises.q: The old building may ______ pulled down next year.
exercises.explain: may be pulled down 表示“可能被拆除”。

exercises.q: The letter must is written in English.
exercises.explain: must 后不能接 is，应改为 must be written。

exercises.q: We must protect the environment. (改为被动语态)
exercises.explain: must be protected 是含情态动词的被动语态。

exercises.q: The possibility of getting hurt ______ completely ruled out by the new design.
exercises.explain: 含情态动词的被动语态 can be ruled out 表示“可以被排除”。

exercises.q: The risk of injury can ______ reduced by wearing protective equipment.
exercises.explain: can be reduced 是含情态动词的被动语态。

exercises.q: The possibility of failure cannot be ruled out completely.
exercises.explain: cannot be ruled out 是含情态动词的被动语态，结构正确。

exercises.q: The company will rule out any unsafe design. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: Any unsafe design will be ruled out by the company.
exercises.explain: will be ruled out 是一般将来时的被动语态。

exercises.q: The possibility of getting hurt can is completely ruled out.
exercises.answer: The possibility of getting hurt can be completely ruled out.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 can 后应接 be，不能接 is。

exercises.q: The safety rules ______ ignored under any circumstances.
exercises.explain: must not be ignored 表示“绝不能被忽视”。

exercises.q: The final decision ______ made until all the facts have been collected.
exercises.explain: should not be made 表示“不应该被做出”。

exercises.q: These ancient documents ______ handled with great care.
exercises.explain: must be handled 表示“必须被小心处理”。

exercises.q: The results of the experiment ______ explained by several factors.
exercises.explain: may be explained 表示“可能被解释”。

exercises.q: The match ____ because of rain.
exercises.explain: 可能被推迟：may be delayed。

exercises.q: The old hall ____ next year.
exercises.explain: 不确定的将来被动。

exercises.q: Choose the best for a polite suggestion.
options: The floor must be washed now.
The floor should be washed after the game.
exercises.answer: The floor should be washed after the game.
exercises.explain: should be 表应当。

exercises.q: These devices ____ by phones later.
exercises.explain: could be + replaced 表可能被取代。

exercises.q: All the data must ______ analyzed before the report is written.
exercises.explain: must be analyzed 表示“必须被分析”。

exercises.q: The old rules should ______ replaced by new ones.
exercises.explain: should be replaced 表示“应该被替换”。

exercises.q: The safety measures must are improved immediately.
exercises.explain: must 后不能接 are，应改为 must be improved。

exercises.q: The government must take immediate action to solve the problem. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: Immediate action must be taken to solve the problem by the government.
exercises.explain: must be taken 是含情态动词的被动语态。

exercises.q: People should not ignore the potential risks. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: The potential risks should not be ignored.
exercises.explain: should not be ignored 是含情态动词的被动语态否定形式。

exercises.q: The safety rules ______ by every visitor before entering the park.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 must 后接 be 加过去分词，构成含情态动词的被动语态。

exercises.q: The homework ______ (must / finish) before Friday.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 must 后接 be 加过去分词，构成被动语态。

exercises.q: The sentence "The door can opened by this key." is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 can 后必须接 be 加过去分词，应改为 can be opened。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in passive voice: You must clean the room.
exercises.explain: 主动语态变被动语态时，宾语 the room 作主语，情态动词后接 be 加过去分词。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: The letter can sent by email.
exercises.answer: The letter can be sent by email.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 can 后缺少 be，应改为 can be sent。

exercises.q: This broken machine ______ immediately, or someone may get hurt.
exercises.explain: should 后接 be 加过去分词，表示“应该被修理”。

exercises.q: The final decision ______ by the manager tomorrow.
exercises.explain: will 是情态动词，后接 be 加过去分词构成被动语态。

exercises.q: Dangerous items ______ into the exhibition hall.
exercises.explain: 情态动词否定式 must not 后接 be 加过去分词，表示“禁止被带入”。

exercises.q: The windows ______ before the storm comes.
exercises.explain: can 后接 be 加过去分词，表示“能够被关上”。

exercises.q: The possibility of injury ____ completely, but it can be reduced.
exercises.explain: rule out 的被动：be ruled out。

exercises.q: Soft surfaces mean a hard fall ____ more easily.
exercises.explain: 能够被避免。

exercises.q: If coverage is weak, the operation ____.
exercises.explain: 医疗安全用 must be postponed。

exercises.q: Headsets ____ by smartphones, according to the writer.
exercises.explain: 课文结构：could be replaced。

exercises.q: Which sentence reports a possibility, not a duty?
options: The old towers might be abandoned.
exercises.answer: The old towers might be abandoned.
exercises.explain: might be 表可能。

exercises.q: These old photos ______ (can / keep) in this box.
exercises.explain: can 后接 be 加过去分词，表示“可以被保存”。

exercises.q: The report ______ (should / write) in English.
exercises.explain: should 后接 be 加过去分词，表示“应该被写”。

exercises.q: The sentence "The rules must be obeyed by everyone." is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: must be obeyed 是含情态动词的被动语态，结构正确。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in passive voice: They can solve the problem.
exercises.explain: 宾语 the problem 变为主语，can 后接 be 加过去分词 solved。

exercises.q: The injured player ______ off the field by the medical team a moment ago.
exercises.explain: had to 是 must 的过去式，后接 be 加过去分词，表示过去不得不被抬走。

exercises.q: The broken window ______ (have to / repair) before winter arrives.
exercises.explain: have to 后接 be 加过去分词，主语为单数，用 has to be repaired。

exercises.q: The sentence "The project might be finished ahead of schedule." is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: might be finished 是含情态动词 might 的被动语态，结构正确。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in passive voice: The committee may discuss the proposal next week.

exercises.explain: 宾语 the proposal 作主语，may 后接 be 加过去分词 discussed。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: The package should be deliver by noon.

exercises.q: These documents ______ in a safe place so that they won't be lost.

exercises.q: A public good ____ to those already connected.

exercises.q: The sentence "The proposal is to be reconsidered at the next meeting." is grammatically correct.

grammar.title: 结果与目的：so / so...that / such...that / so that / too...to
grammar.titleEn: Result and purpose: so, so...that, such...that, so that, too...to
grammar.usage:
so 引导结果状语从句时，表示“因此、所以”，用来引出前面情况所导致的自然结果或实际后果。其核心结构为：原因分句 + so + 结果分句。so 是并列连词，连接两个在逻辑上具有因果关系的分句，前一分句说明原因或条件，后一分句说明由此产生的结果。

肯定句结构为“原因分句 + so + 结果分句”，否定句和疑问句的变化主要体现在结果分句内部，so 本身不参与否定或疑问的构成。例如否定结果时，在结果分句的谓语部分加否定词；疑问句则对结果分句进行提问。so 引导结果状语从句时，通常位于句首的原因分句之后，不能置于句首单独引导结果。

so 与 so that 是高中阶段最易混淆的一组结构。so 引导结果状语从句，表示“因此、所以”，强调已经发生或必然发生的结果；so that 引导目的状语从句，表示“为了、以便”，强调主观意图和目的，且目的状语从句中常含有情态动词 can / could / may / might / will / would。此外，so...that... 是另一个独立结构，表示“如此……以至于……”，其中 so 修饰形容词或副词，that 引导结果状语从句，与单独使用 so 连接两个分句的结构不同。

初中阶段主要要求掌握 so 表示“所以”的基本用法，并能与 because 进行简单辨析。高中阶段则进一步要求：第一，在书面表达中准确区分 so（结果）与 so that（目的），避免混用；第二，理解 so 在语篇中的逻辑衔接功能，能够判断前后句的因果关系是否成立；第三，掌握 so...that... 与 such...that... 的转换关系，以及 so...that... 结构中 so 置于句首时的倒装现象。

易错点一：because 与 so 不能同时出现在同一个句子中。英语中一个句子只能有一个表示因果关系的连词，because 引导原因状语从句时，主句前不能再加 so。易错点二：so 与 so that 的语义混淆。判断标准是看从句表达的是“实际结果”还是“主观目的”。易错点三：so...that... 结构中 that 在口语或非正式文体中可以省略，但在书面语中建议保留，以免造成结构不清。易错点四：so 作为连词连接两个分句时，前面通常用逗号与原因分句隔开；但在较短的句子中，逗号可以省略。
forms: 原因分句 + so + 结果分句（肯定式）
原因分句 + so + 结果分句（否定式：结果分句谓语加 not/never）
原因分句 + so + 结果分句（疑问式：对结果分句进行提问）
so + 形容词/副词 + that + 结果状语从句（so...that... 结构）
so + 形容词 + a/an + 单数可数名词 + that 从句（书面语/正式语体）
so + many/few + 复数名词 + that 从句 / so + much/little + 不可数名词 + that 从句
notes: because 与 so 不可连用：英语中一个句子只能保留一个因果连词，because 引导原因状语从句时，主句前不能再加 so。高考短文改错和语法填空中常以此设置陷阱。
so 与 so that 的语域差异：so 引导结果状语从句，语气直接、口语化；so that 引导目的状语从句，书面语色彩更强，且从句中常出现情态动词 can/could/may/might。高考书面表达中应根据语境选择。
so...that... 与 such...that... 的转换：so 修饰形容词或副词，such 修饰名词。当名词前有 many/much/few/little 等表示数量的词时，只能用 so，不能用 such。这是高考语法填空的高频考点。
so...that... 结构中 so 置于句首时，主句需部分倒装。例如：So fast did he run that nobody could catch him. 这种倒装结构属于高中书面语中的高级表达，适用于高考写作提分。
so 连接两个分句时，逗号的使用在正式书面语中较为规范，但在新闻标题、广告语等简洁语域中可以省略逗号。高考写作中建议保留逗号以体现逻辑清晰。

examples.en: I was tired, so I went to bed early.
examples.cn: 我累了，所以早早上床睡觉了。

examples.en: The bus was late, so we had to wait for a long time.
examples.cn: 公交车晚点了，所以我们不得不等了很长时间。

examples.en: He didn't bring his umbrella, so he got wet in the rain.
examples.cn: 他没有带伞，所以被雨淋湿了。

examples.en: We booked the indoor court so that the rain could not stop the game.
examples.cn: 我们订了室内场，好让雨无法打断比赛。

examples.en: The surface was too uneven to land safely, so the coach stopped the drill.
examples.cn: 地面太不平，无法安全落地，所以教练停了训练。

examples.en: Delay was reduced so sharply that surgeons began to trust remote tools they would once have refused.
examples.cn: 延迟降得如此之低，外科医生开始信任他们一度拒绝的远程工具。

exercises.q: I was hungry, ______ I ate a sandwich.
exercises.explain: so 连接原因和结果，表示“所以”。

exercises.q: He was late, ______ he ran to school.
exercises.explain: 迟到是原因，跑着去是结果，填 so。

exercises.q: The sentence "It rained, so we took an umbrella." means we took an umbrella because it rained.
exercises.explain: so 表示结果，带伞是下雨的结果。

exercises.q: I was thirsty. I drank some water. (用 so 合并句子)
exercises.answer: I was thirsty, so I drank some water.
exercises.explain: 用 so 连接原因和结果两个分句。

exercises.q: Because it was cold, so I wore a coat.
exercises.answer: Because it was cold, I wore a coat. / It was cold, so I wore a coat.
exercises.explain: because 和 so 不能同时使用，二者选一。

exercises.q: The box was heavy, ______ Tom asked for help.
exercises.explain: 前因“箱子重”导致结果“求助”，用 so。

exercises.q: It was very cold, ______ we stayed inside.
exercises.explain: 天气冷是原因，待在家里是结果，用 so 连接。

exercises.q: She was tired, ______ she went to bed early.
exercises.explain: 累了所以早睡，so 表示结果。

exercises.q: The movie was boring, ______ we left early.
exercises.explain: 电影无聊导致提前离开，用 so 表结果。

exercises.q: It was cold, ____ we stayed inside.
exercises.explain: 两个完整分句用 so 表结果。

exercises.q: The box is ____ heavy that I cannot move it.
exercises.explain: so + adj + that。

exercises.q: It was ____ a nice day that we went out.
exercises.explain: such a + adj + 名词。

exercises.q: He got up early ____ he could catch the bus.
exercises.explain: 目的用 so that。

exercises.q: The tea is ____ hot to drink.
exercises.explain: too + adj + to。

exercises.q: The bag was full, ______ I couldn't put more books in it.
exercises.explain: 包满了所以放不下更多书，用 so 连接结果。

exercises.q: She didn't feel well, ______ she saw a doctor.
exercises.explain: 不舒服所以去看医生，填 so。

exercises.q: In the sentence "He was hungry, so he ate lunch.", the word "so" means "because".
exercises.explain: so 表示“所以”，because 表示“因为”，意思不同。

exercises.q: The bus was late. We waited at the station. (用 so 合并句子)
exercises.answer: The bus was late, so we waited at the station.
exercises.explain: 前因后果用 so 连接。

exercises.q: The music was too loud, ______ we couldn't hear each other.
exercises.explain: 音乐太响导致听不见，so 表结果。

exercises.q: He didn't set his alarm, ______ he overslept.
exercises.explain: 没设闹钟导致睡过头，填 so。

exercises.q: The sentence "He ran fast, so he caught the bus." means he caught the bus because he ran fast.
exercises.explain: 跑得快是原因，赶上公交是结果。

exercises.q: The weather was bad. The match was cancelled. (用 so 合并句子)
exercises.answer: The weather was bad, so the match was cancelled.
exercises.explain: 天气差导致比赛取消，用 so 连接。

exercises.q: Because the traffic was heavy, so we arrived late.
exercises.answer: Because the traffic was heavy, we arrived late. / The traffic was heavy, so we arrived late.
exercises.explain: because 和 so 不能同时出现在一个句子中。

exercises.q: He studied hard, ______ he passed the exam easily.
exercises.explain: 努力是原因，通过是结果，用 so。

exercises.q: The road was icy, ______ the car skidded off the road.

grammar.key: Present Simple Tense for General Facts/Habits
grammar.title: 一般现在时：事实、习惯、时刻表，兼辨现在进行时与 always 抱怨用法
grammar.titleEn: Present simple for facts, habits, timetables (vs progressive)
grammar.usage:
一般现在时主要用来表达普遍真理、客观事实、经常性或习惯性的动作，以及当前一段时期内相对稳定的状态。其核心结构为“主语 + 动词原形/动词第三人称单数形式 + 其他”。当主语是第三人称单数（he/she/it 或单数名词）时，行为动词需要加 -s 或 -es；be 动词则根据主语分别使用 am/is/are。肯定句中动词形式随主语变化，否定句和疑问句需要借助助动词 do/does 构成，此时助动词已经体现人称和数，后面的实义动词必须恢复原形。例如肯定句“She likes music.”，否定句是“She does not/doesn't like music.”，疑问句是“Does she like music?”。

在初中阶段，一般现在时主要考查第三人称单数动词变化、do/does 的基本用法以及 always、usually、often、sometimes、every day 等频率副词或时间状语的搭配。进入高中阶段后，一般现在时往往不再单独作为简单考点出现，而是与情态动词、被动语态、定语从句、主语从句等结构结合，用来表达普遍性判断、客观评价或长期有效的观点。例如“Weekends are a special time that shouldn't be wasted easily.”中，主句“Weekends are...”用一般现在时说明普遍事实，从句中“shouldn't be wasted”则是情态动词被动结构，表达的是一种普遍性建议，而不是一次性动作。

与现在进行时相比，一般现在时强调常态、习惯或事实，而现在进行时强调说话时正在发生或现阶段暂时进行的动作。例如“He usually plays basketball after school.”表示习惯，而“He is playing basketball now.”表示此刻正在发生。部分动词如 know、believe、like、want、belong 等表示心理状态、情感或所属关系，通常只用于一般现在时，不用于进行时。

易错点一：第三人称单数动词变化规则掌握不牢，尤其以辅音字母加 y 结尾的动词要变 y 为 i 再加 -es，如 study→studies，但 play→plays。易错点二：否定句和疑问句中用了 does/do 后，实义动词仍误加 -s/-es，如“He doesn't likes...”是错误的。易错点三：在复合句或含有情态动词的被动结构中，误把整个结构都写成过去时或进行时，忽略了普遍事实和一般性观点应使用一般现在时。易错点四：把表示客观事实的句子与表示一次性安排或临时情况的句子混用，例如描述自然规律、科学结论时应使用一般现在时，而不是现在进行时或一般将来时。
forms: 肯定句：主语 + 动词原形/动词第三人称单数形式 + 其他。（I/You/We/They work. He/She/It works.）
否定句：主语 + do/does + not + 动词原形 + 其他。（I don't work. He doesn't work.）
一般疑问句：Do/Does + 主语 + 动词原形 + 其他？（Do you work? Does she work?）
be 动词一般现在时：主语 + am/is/are + 表语。（Weekends are a special time.）
情态动词被动结构：主语 + 情态动词 + be + 过去分词。（Weekends shouldn't be wasted easily.）
频率副词位置：主语 + 频率副词 + 动词；be 动词后接频率副词。（She usually goes by bus. He is always late.）
notes: 高考书面表达中，描述图表、社会现象或普遍规律时，应优先使用一般现在时，避免随意切换成过去时或将来时。
在“It is important/necessary/natural that...”等主语从句结构中，从句常用一般现在时表达普遍观点，注意不要因主句时态变化而误改从句时态。
情态动词被动结构“shouldn't be wasted”表达的是一般性建议，不是过去发生的事，语域上属于正式书面语，适合议论文或说明文。
一般现在时与现在进行时在语域上有分工：正式说明、定义、科学结论用一般现在时；口语中描述眼前临时动作才用进行时。
第三人称单数动词变化中，以 -ch、-sh、-s、-x、-o 结尾的动词加 -es，如 teach→teaches、go→goes，高考语法填空常考此类拼写。

grammar.title: 比较级叠用：adj-er and adj-er / more and more / the more..., the more...
grammar.titleEn: Double comparatives: closer and closer, more and more, the more...the more
grammar.usage:
本语法点核心结构为“比较级 + and + 比较级”，用来表达某一性质在程度上的持续增强或变化，相当于汉语的“越来越……”。该结构可细分为两类：单音节及部分双音节形容词、副词用“-er and -er”形式，如 closer and closer, faster and faster；多音节或部分双音节形容词、副词则用“more and more + 原级”形式，如 more and more beautiful, more and more carefully。

肯定句直接使用该结构作表语、状语或定语，例如：The city is becoming more and more modern. 否定句通常在谓语部分否定，而不是否定比较级本身，例如：It isn't getting any colder. 或 The situation is not becoming more and more serious. 疑问句则借助助动词或系动词提前，例如：Is the problem becoming more and more serious? 注意该结构本身不因疑问或否定而改变形式。

与近义结构对比：本结构强调“同一性质程度不断加深”，而“比较级 + than”强调两者之间的比较，例如 He is taller than his brother 并不表示“越来越高”。另外，“the + 比较级, the + 比较级”结构表示“越……就越……”，强调两个变化之间的关联，如 The more you practice, the better you become，与本结构侧重点不同。

初中阶段主要要求掌握常见单音节形容词的“-er and -er”形式以及“more and more + 多音节形容词”的基本用法，多用于描述天气、人物感受等日常话题。高中阶段则进一步要求：在书面表达中灵活运用该结构描写趋势、变化过程；注意与副词连用，如 work more and more efficiently；理解该结构在正式语体中的替代表达，如 increasingly + 形容词，以提升表达的多样性和正式度。

易错点：一是忘记双写末尾辅音字母，如 big 应变为 bigger and bigger，而不是 biger and biger；二是把多音节形容词误加 -er，如不能说 beautifuler and beautifuler；三是混淆“more and more + 原级”与“more + 比较级”的搭配，如不能说 more and more better；四是在否定句中误把比较级变成原级，例如不能说 It isn't getting colder and colder 而应说 It isn't getting any colder。
forms: 单音节形容词/副词：adj./adv.-er + and + adj./adv.-er（如 faster and faster）
多音节形容词/副词：more and more + adj./adv. 原级（如 more and more important）
表语用法：主语 + 系动词 + 比较级 and 比较级（如 The noise is getting louder and louder）
状语用法：主语 + 谓语 + more and more + 副词原级（如 She speaks more and more fluently）
定语用法：more and more + 形容词原级 + 名词（如 more and more people）
正式书面语替代：increasingly + 形容词原级（如 increasingly difficult）
notes: 高考书面表达中，连续使用“more and more”容易显得重复，可适当替换为 increasingly、growingly 等副词，提升语域正式度。
注意“more and more + 名词”结构中的名词通常为可数名词复数或不可数名词，如 more and more students，而不是 more and more student。
该结构强调同一主体的程度变化，不要与“比较级 + than”的双方比较混用；若句中出现 than，则不能再用 and 连接两个比较级。
部分双音节形容词有两种比较级形式，如 clever → cleverer / more clever，但在“越来越……”结构中通常只取一种，避免混搭，如不说 more and more cleverer。
在正式书面语中，该结构多用于描述趋势、变化过程，不宜用于静态事实描述，如不宜说 The mountain is higher and higher 来表示山本身很高。

grammar.title: 将来：will 预测 / be going to 迹象与打算 / 进行时表安排 / may, might
grammar.titleEn: Future forms: will, be going to, present continuous, may/might
grammar.usage:
“will + 动词原形”表示对将来情况的预测，即说话人根据主观判断、经验或对未来的推测，认为某事将会发生。这种预测通常不强调事先安排或已有迹象，而是表达一种对未来的信念或看法。核心结构为：主语 + will + 动词原形，否定形式在 will 后加 not（可缩写为 won't），疑问形式将 will 提到主语之前。

在高中阶段，will 表预测需要与 be going to 进行区分。be going to 多用于两种情况：一是表示事先计划、打算做某事；二是表示根据现有迹象判断某事即将发生。而 will 更侧重于说话人的主观判断、推测或对遥远未来的预测，常与 I think、I believe、probably、perhaps、in the future 等搭配。

此外，高中英语还要求掌握其他情态动词表预测的用法。may 和 might 表示“可能”，语气比 will 弱，其中 might 比 may 更不确定；could 也可以表示“有可能”，但语气同样较为委婉。在书面语和高考阅读中，这些情态动词常与 will 交替出现，以体现预测的确定程度差异。

初中阶段主要要求掌握 will 的基本结构以及 will 与 be going to 的简单区别；高中阶段则进一步要求能在语境中根据预测的确定程度选择 will、may、might、could，并能在书面表达中灵活运用，避免一味使用 will 造成语气过于绝对。
forms: 肯定句：主语 + will + 动词原形
否定句：主语 + will not (won't) + 动词原形
一般疑问句：Will + 主语 + 动词原形?
be going to + 动词原形（表计划或已有迹象的预测）
主语 + may / might / could + 动词原形（表可能性较弱的预测）
There will be + 名词（表某事物将来会出现）
notes: will 表预测时后必须接动词原形，不可接 to do 或 doing；高考短文改错和语法填空中常在此设错。
will 与 be going to 并非完全等同：表示“根据现有迹象判断即将发生”时，书面语中更倾向用 be going to，如 Look at the clouds. It is going to rain.
在高考书面表达中，连续使用 will 会使语气过于绝对，可适当换用 may、might 或 be likely to，以体现语言丰富性和预测的层次感。
will 表预测时，时间状语并非必须出现，但在科技类说明文或议论文中，常与 in the future、by 2050、in the coming years 等搭配，以明确预测的时间范围。
注意 will 与 would 的语域差异：would 可用于过去将来时的预测，也可使语气更委婉，在间接引语和虚拟语气中常见，高考语法填空需根据主句时态判断是否用 would。

exercises.explain: 一般疑问句将 will 提到主语前。

exercises.q: By the time you arrive, the concert ______ already ______.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导时间状语，用将来完成时表示将来某时已完成的动作。

exercises.q: By 2050, the world's population ______ (reach) nine billion.
exercises.explain: by 2050 用将来完成时表示到那时已完成的预测。

exercises.q: The sentence 'By next year, she will have graduated from college.' is correct.
exercises.explain: by next year 用将来完成时 will have graduated，结构正确。

exercises.q: Rewrite using 'will have done': By the end of this year, she will finish her research.
exercises.answer: By the end of this year, she will have finished her research.
exercises.explain: by the end of this year 用将来完成时 will have finished。

exercises.q: Find and correct the mistake: By 2030, scientists will have find a cure for the disease.
exercises.answer: By 2030, scientists will have found a cure for the disease.
exercises.explain: 将来完成时用 will have found，find 应改为过去分词 found。

exercises.q: The new technology ______ widely used in the next decade.
exercises.explain: in the next decade 是将来时间，用 will be 表预测。

exercises.q: If global warming continues, many coastal cities ______ under water.
exercises.explain: if 条件句表将来预测，主句用 will be。

exercises.q: I doubt whether he ______ the truth.
exercises.explain: doubt whether 后接将来时，表示对将来行为的怀疑。

exercises.q: The company has announced that it ______ a new factory in the region.
exercises.explain: has announced 后接 that 从句，用 will build 表示将来计划。

exercises.q: Internet devices ____ allow faster communication.
exercises.explain: 课文预测。

exercises.q: The notice says the outing ____ at 8, so we use present.
exercises.explain: 时刻表现在时。

exercises.q: I ____ the coach as soon as he arrives. (promise)
exercises.explain: 承诺。

exercises.q: They ____ a new court next month; the money is ready.
exercises.explain: 已有条件的打算。

exercises.q: Coverage ____ still be weak in the hills.
exercises.explain: 留有余地。

exercises.q: The government predicts that the economy ______ (grow) by 3% next year.
exercises.explain: predicts 后接 that 从句，用 will grow 表示预测。

exercises.q: Unless we act now, the problem ______ (become) worse.
exercises.explain: unless 条件句表将来，主句用 will become。

exercises.q: The sentence 'He will be able to speak three languages by the time he is ten.' is correct.
exercises.explain: will be able to 表示将来能力，by the time 引导时间状语，结构正确。

exercises.q: Rewrite as a negative sentence: The government will approve the new law.
exercises.answer: The government will not approve the new law.
exercises.explain: 否定形式在 will 后加 not。

exercises.q: By 2030, most cars on the road ______ electric.
exercises.explain: will 后必须接动词原形，be 是原形，其他选项形式错误。

exercises.q: Scientists believe that sea levels ______ rise in the next fifty years.
exercises.explain: 根据科学家预测，用 will 表示对未来的客观预测。

exercises.q: The sentence 'He will goes to school tomorrow' is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: will 后必须接动词原形 go，不能接 goes。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in negative form: The meeting will start at 9 a.m.
exercises.answer: The meeting will not start at 9 a.m.
exercises.explain: 否定形式在 will 后加 not，后接动词原形。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: The weather will gets colder next month.
exercises.answer: The weather will get colder next month.
exercises.explain: will 后必须接动词原形 get，不能接 gets。

exercises.q: I think it ______ tomorrow, so take an umbrella.
exercises.explain: will 表对未来的预测，后接动词原形 rain。

exercises.q: Don't worry about the exam. You ______ fine.
exercises.explain: will 后接动词原形 do，表示对对方未来表现的预测。

exercises.q: In the future, people ______ on Mars.
exercises.explain: will 表未来预测，后接动词原形 live。

exercises.q: The new technology ______ communication much faster.
exercises.explain: will 后接动词原形 make，表示对未来技术影响的预测。

exercises.q: Connected devices ____ communication with reduced delay.
exercises.explain: 课文。

exercises.q: If the yellow warning stays, we ____ cancel, though nothing is decided.
exercises.explain: 未决定。

exercises.q: The committee ____ on Friday; seats are booked.
exercises.explain: 已定安排。

exercises.q: Look at the empty towers. They ____ unused for months.
exercises.explain: 眼前迹象。

exercises.q: I ____ the door — that is a decision as I speak.
exercises.explain: 即时决定。

exercises.q: She ______ (be) a great doctor one day.
exercises.explain: will 后接动词原形 be，表示对未来的预测。

exercises.q: The Internet of Things ______ (change) our daily lives completely.
exercises.explain: will 后接动词原形 change，表示对未来变化的预测。

exercises.q: In the sentence 'I will call you tonight', 'will' expresses a prediction about the future.
exercises.explain: will 在这里表示对将来行为的预测或承诺，属于将来时用法。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence as a question: You will finish the project next week.
exercises.answer: Will you finish the project next week?
exercises.explain: 一般疑问句将 will 提到主语之前，后接动词原形。

exercises.q: By the time you arrive, the concert ______ already ______.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导将来时间状语，主句用将来完成时 will have done 表示将来某时已完成的动作。

exercises.q: This time next week, we ______ (fly) to London.
exercises.explain: this time next week 表示将来某一具体时刻，用将来进行时。

exercises.q: The sentence 'By 2050, the population will have reached 10 billion' uses the future perfect tense correctly.
exercises.explain: by 2050 表示到将来某时为止，用将来完成时 will have done 正确。

exercises.q: Rewrite using 'will have done': By next month, she will finish her thesis.
exercises.answer: By next month, she will have finished her thesis.
exercises.explain: by next month 表示到将来某时为止，用将来完成时 will have finished。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: By the time you get home, I will finished my homework.
exercises.answer: By the time you get home, I will have finished my homework.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导将来时间，主句用将来完成时 will have done。

exercises.q: Don't call me at 8 p.m. I ______ dinner with my family then.
exercises.explain: 将来某一具体时刻正在进行的动作，用将来进行时 will be doing。

exercises.q: Look at those dark clouds! It ______ soon.
exercises.explain: 有迹象表明即将发生的事，用 be going to 而非 will。

exercises.q: I'm not sure if he ______ the job, but I think he has a good chance.
exercises.explain: 表示不确定的预测，用 will 而非 be going to。

exercises.q: By next year, the company ______ its new product line.
exercises.explain: by next year 表示到将来某时为止，用将来完成时 will have done。

exercises.q: A rumour repeated without check ____ be treated as fact.
exercises.explain: 预测性后果。

exercises.q: The pipes are shaking. They ____ burst.
exercises.explain: 迹象。

exercises.q: We ____ the audit next Monday; the room is reserved.
exercises.explain: 安排。

exercises.q: Rural pages ____ still be missing when the brochure is printed.
exercises.explain: 留余地。

exercises.q: — The footnote is ugly. — Fine, I ____ it.
exercises.explain: 即时决定。

exercises.q: By the end of this century, scientists ______ (discover) a cure for many diseases.
exercises.explain: by the end of this century 表示到将来某时为止，用将来完成时。

exercises.q: The train ______ (leave) at 6 p.m. tomorrow, so don't be late.
exercises.explain: 按时刻表发生的将来事件，用 will 或一般现在时均可，此处用 will leave 表预测。

exercises.q: In the sentence 'I will be studying at 9 p.m. tomorrow', the action is a completed action in the future.
exercises.explain: will be doing 表示将来某时正在进行的动作，不是已完成。

exercises.q: Rewrite as a negative sentence: The company will be expanding its operations next year.
exercises.answer: The company will not be expanding its operations next year.
exercises.explain: 将来进行时的否定在 will 后加 not，保持 be doing 结构。

exercises.q: Had the technology been available a decade earlier, the company ______ the market.
exercises.explain: 与过去事实相反的虚拟条件句，主句用 would have done。

exercises.q: By the time the project is completed, the team ______ (invest) over five years in research.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导将来时间，主句用将来完成时表示到那时已投入的时间。

exercises.q: The sentence 'By 2030, the technology will have been widely adopted' is in the future perfect passive voice.
exercises.explain: will have been adopted 是将来完成时的被动语态，结构正确。

exercises.q: Rewrite using the future perfect passive: By 2035, they will have replaced all fossil fuel vehicles.
exercises.answer: By 2035, all fossil fuel vehicles will have been replaced.
exercises.explain: 将来完成时被动语态结构为 will have been done。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: By the time the conference ends, the speakers will have been discussing the topic for three hours.
exercises.answer: By the time the conference ends, the speakers will have discussed the topic for three hours.
exercises.explain: 强调到将来某时已完成的动作，用将来完成时 will have discussed，而非将来完成进行时。

exercises.q: By the time the new regulations take effect, the industry ______ significantly.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导将来时间，主句用将来完成时表示到那时已完成的转变。

exercises.q: The report predicts that artificial intelligence ______ nearly every aspect of our lives within two decades.
exercises.explain: within two decades 表示到将来某时为止，用将来完成时强调完成的变革。

exercises.q: If current trends continue, sea levels ______ by at least 30 centimeters by 2100.
exercises.explain: by 2100 表示到将来某时为止，用将来完成时表示已上升的幅度。

exercises.q: At this time next year, the researchers ______ clinical trials on the new drug.
exercises.explain: at this time next year 表示将来某一具体时刻，用将来进行时。

exercises.q: A city that funds only downtown ____ design itself around the connected.
exercises.explain: 制度性预测。

exercises.q: The old pipes groan. The street ____ flood.
exercises.explain: 迹象。

exercises.q: Ministers ____ at dawn; the slot is in the diary.
exercises.explain: 安排。

exercises.q: The unconnected ____ remain uninvited unless the map changes.
exercises.explain: 条件不确定。

exercises.q: — This sentence hides the cost. — Then I ____ it.
exercises.explain: 即时决定。

exercises.q: The company predicts that its new device ______ (replace) traditional smartphones within a decade.
exercises.explain: within a decade 表示到将来某时为止，用将来完成时强调已完成的替代。

exercises.q: At 10 a.m. tomorrow, the engineers ______ (test) the new system.
exercises.explain: at 10 a.m. tomorrow 表示将来某一具体时刻，用将来进行时。

exercises.q: In the sentence 'The new policy will be implemented next year', 'will be implemented' is a future continuous passive.
exercises.explain: will be implemented 是一般将来时的被动语态，不是将来进行时被动。

exercises.q: Rewrite using 'will be doing': The scientists will conduct experiments at 9 a.m. tomorrow.
exercises.answer: The scientists will be conducting experiments at 9 a.m. tomorrow.
exercises.explain: 将来某一具体时刻正在进行的动作，用将来进行时 will be doing。

grammar.title: 对比连接：in contrast / however / whereas / while / on the other hand / although
grammar.titleEn: Contrast: in contrast, however, whereas, while, on the other hand, although
grammar.usage:
“In contrast” 是一个表示“鲜明对比”的连接短语，用来引出与前面所述内容在性质、程度、特点等方面明显不同的信息。它强调两个对象、观点或事实之间的差异，而不是简单的补充或因果。

核心结构上，“In contrast” 通常位于句首，后面用逗号与主句隔开，形成“In contrast, + 完整句子”的格式。它既可以连接两个独立的句子，也可以在一个段落中引出与前文相对的新信息。肯定句中直接使用“In contrast, A does/is...”；否定句中则写“In contrast, A does not / is not...”；疑问句中较少直接使用，但可以出现在对比性提问中，如“In contrast, what does B offer?”。

与近义结构相比，“In contrast” 偏向书面语和正式语体，强调客观对比；“On the other hand” 更常用于引出另一种观点或事物的另一面，语气稍缓和；“However” 是副词，表示转折，但不一定强调两者之间的直接对比；“Whereas” 和 “While” 是从属连词，常放在句中连接两个分句；“Unlike” 是介词，后面直接接名词或代词，表示“与……不同”。

初中阶段，学生主要接触 “but” 和 “however” 表示转折，对 “in contrast” 的要求以识别和理解为主，常见于阅读理解中判断逻辑关系。高中阶段则要求能够在书面表达中主动运用 “in contrast” 来增强论证的层次感和正式感，同时能够根据语境在 “in contrast / on the other hand / whereas / unlike” 之间做出恰当选择。

易错点一：把 “in contrast” 当作连词直接连接两个句子，写成 “A is fast, in contrast B is slow”，这是错误的，正确写法应为 “A is fast. In contrast, B is slow.” 或使用分号。易错点二：混淆 “in contrast” 与 “on the contrary”。“on the contrary” 表示“恰恰相反”，用于否定前文观点并给出相反判断，而 “in contrast” 只是客观呈现差异，不一定要否定前文。易错点三：在口语或非正式写作中过度使用 “in contrast”，会显得生硬，此时可换用 “but” 或 “on the other hand”。易错点四：使用 “in contrast to” 时后面接名词或动名词，而不是接完整句子，例如 “In contrast to his brother, John is outgoing.”
forms: In contrast, + 完整句子（肯定/否定/疑问）
In contrast to + 名词/代词/动名词, + 完整句子
A is... In contrast, B is...（两个独立句子，句号分隔）
A is...; in contrast, B is...（分号连接，in contrast 小写）
Whereas/While + 从句, + 主句（表示对比，句中位置）
Unlike + 名词/代词, + 完整句子（表示“与……不同”）
notes: “In contrast” 是介词短语，不是连词，不能直接连接两个完整句子，必须用句号或分号隔开。
“In contrast to” 后面接名词、代词或动名词，不能接完整句子；接句子时要用 “whereas” 或 “while”。
高考书面表达中，“In contrast” 适合用于议论文和说明文的对比论证，但不要每段都用，一篇作文使用 1–2 次即可，避免重复。
“On the contrary” 表示“恰恰相反”，用于否定前文观点；“In contrast” 只是呈现差异，不否定前文，两者不可混用。
在正式语域中，“In contrast” 比 “but” 和 “on the other hand” 更客观、更书面化，适合学术写作和正式报告。

examples.en: Cats are quiet and independent. In contrast, dogs need more attention.
examples.cn: 猫安静而独立。相比之下，狗需要更多关注。

examples.en: My school is small. In contrast, my cousin's school has over two thousand students.
examples.cn: 我的学校很小。相比之下，我表弟的学校有两千多名学生。

examples.en: In contrast to his earlier novels, the author's latest work focuses on modern city life.
examples.cn: 与他早期的小说相比，这位作者的最新作品聚焦于现代城市生活。

examples.en: Whereas traditional cars rely on petrol, electric vehicles use rechargeable batteries.
examples.cn: 传统汽车依赖汽油，而电动汽车使用可充电电池。

examples.en: The northern region suffers from water shortages. In contrast, the southern provinces enjoy abundant rainfall throughout the year.
examples.cn: 北部地区饱受水资源短缺之苦。相比之下，南部省份全年雨水充沛。

examples.en: Unlike previous economic models, this framework emphasizes sustainability over short-term growth; in contrast, earlier approaches prioritized immediate profits.
examples.cn: 与以往的经济模型不同，这一框架强调可持续性而非短期增长；相比之下，早期的方法优先考虑即时利润。

exercises.q: Tom is very tall. ______, his brother is quite short.
exercises.explain: 前后是身高高矮的对比，用 In contrast 引出相反信息。

exercises.q: The city is noisy and busy. ______, the village is quiet and peaceful.
exercises.explain: 城市吵闹忙碌与乡村安静平和形成对比，句首用 In contrast。

exercises.q: The phrase 'In contrast' is used to show that two things are similar.
exercises.explain: In contrast 表示对比差异，不是表示相似。

exercises.q: The first book is short. The second book is long. (用 In contrast 合并句子)
exercises.answer: The first book is short. In contrast, the second book is long.
exercises.explain: 用 In contrast 连接两个形成对比的句子，注意句首加逗号。

exercises.q: In contrast the weather was cold, we still went swimming.
exercises.answer: In contrast, the weather was cold, but we still went swimming.
exercises.explain: In contrast 后需加逗号，且此处逻辑上应加 but 连接转折。

exercises.q: Cats like to sleep a lot. ______, dogs often want to play outside.
exercises.explain: 猫爱睡觉和狗爱出去玩是两种不同的行为，用 In contrast 表示对比。

exercises.q: The north of the country is cold in winter. ______, the south stays warm.
exercises.explain: 北方冷和南方暖形成明显差异，用 In contrast 连接。

exercises.q: My sister loves pop music. ______, I prefer rock music.
exercises.explain: 姐姐喜欢流行乐和我喜欢摇滚乐是两种不同喜好，用 In contrast 表示对比。

exercises.q: The old phone is heavy and slow. ______, the new one is light and fast.
exercises.explain: 旧手机又重又慢与新手机又轻又快形成对比，用 In contrast 引出差异。

exercises.q: I like bouncing. ____, my sister likes reading.
exercises.explain: 对比。

exercises.q: ____ it rained, we still went.
exercises.explain: 让步。

exercises.q: He is tall, ____ she is short.
exercises.explain: 简单转折。

exercises.q: ____ his brother, Tom is athletic.
exercises.explain: to + 名词。

exercises.q: It was late. ____, we stayed.
exercises.explain: 句首 however。

exercises.q: Some people like hot weather. ______, others enjoy cold weather.
exercises.explain: 喜欢热天和喜欢冷天是两种相反偏好，用 In contrast 引出对比。

exercises.q: The first movie was funny. ______, the second one was very serious.
exercises.explain: 第一部有趣和第二部严肃形成对比，句首用 In contrast。

exercises.q: We usually put a comma after 'In contrast' when it is at the beginning of a sentence.
exercises.explain: In contrast 位于句首时后面通常加逗号。

exercises.q: My room is always clean. My brother's room is always messy. (用 In contrast 改写)
exercises.answer: My room is always clean. In contrast, my brother's room is always messy.
exercises.explain: 两个房间状态形成对比，用 In contrast 引出第二句。

exercises.q: The old system could only handle a few users at a time. ______, the new system supports thousands of users at once.
exercises.explain: 旧系统只能处理少量用户与新系统支持数千用户形成对比，用 In contrast。

exercises.q: The old model was expensive and difficult to use. ______, the new model is cheap and user-friendly.
exercises.explain: 旧型号昂贵难用与新型号便宜好用形成对比，句首用 In contrast。

exercises.q: The phrase 'In contrast' can be used to introduce an example.
exercises.explain: In contrast 用于引出对比信息，不是引出例子。

exercises.q: The old computer takes five minutes to start. The new computer starts in ten seconds. (用 In contrast 合并)
exercises.answer: The old computer takes five minutes to start. In contrast, the new computer starts in ten seconds.
exercises.explain: 旧电脑启动慢与新电脑启动快形成对比，用 In contrast 连接。

exercises.q: The old phone battery lasted only two hours. In contrast the new phone battery lasts two days.
exercises.answer: The old phone battery lasted only two hours. In contrast, the new phone battery lasts two days.
exercises.explain: In contrast 位于句首时后面需要加逗号。

exercises.q: Many people believe that technology makes us busier. ______, others argue that it saves us time.
exercises.explain: 两种相反观点形成对比，用 In contrast 引出不同看法。

exercises.q: The first half of the book is slow and boring. ______, the second half is full of action.
exercises.explain: 书的前半部分无聊与后半部分充满动作形成对比，用 In contrast。

exercises.q: Traditional phones could only make calls. ______, smartphones can do many things like taking photos and surfing the Internet.
exercises.explain: 传统手机功能单一与智能手机功能多样形成对比，用 In contrast。

exercises.q: The north of the city is modern and developed. ______, the south remains quite traditional.
exercises.explain: 城市北部现代与南部传统形成对比，用 In contrast 引出差异。

exercises.q: John is outgoing. ____, his brother is shy.
exercises.explain: 性格对比。

exercises.q: The court is new, ____ it is already packed.
exercises.explain: 转折而非对比对象。

exercises.q: ____ 4G, 5G promises higher speed.
exercises.explain: to + 名词。

exercises.q: She trained hard; she lost, ____.
exercises.explain: 句末 however。

exercises.q: I like indoor courts, ____ he likes parks.
exercises.explain: 对比两人。

exercises.q: Some students prefer to study alone. ______, others learn better in groups.
exercises.explain: 独自学习和小组学习是两种不同偏好，用 In contrast 引出对比。

exercises.q: The first experiment failed completely. ______, the second experiment was a great success.
exercises.explain: 第一次实验失败与第二次实验成功形成对比，用 In contrast。

exercises.q: 'In contrast' and 'However' can both be used to show a difference between two ideas.
exercises.explain: In contrast 和 However 都可以表示对比或转折。

exercises.q: Some people enjoy living in big cities. Others prefer the quiet life in the countryside. (用 In contrast 改写)
exercises.answer: Some people enjoy living in big cities. In contrast, others prefer the quiet life in the countryside.
exercises.explain: 喜欢大城市生活和喜欢乡村宁静生活形成对比，用 In contrast 引出第二句。

exercises.q: The previous generation of mobile networks focused mainly on voice calls. ______, 5G is designed to connect billions of devices with extremely low latency.
exercises.explain: 前代网络侧重语音通话与5G侧重海量设备连接形成对比，用 In contrast。

exercises.q: The old network could only support a few hundred connections per cell. ______, 5G can support up to a million connections in the same area.
exercises.explain: 旧网络连接数少与5G连接数多形成对比，句首用 In contrast。

exercises.q: The phrase 'In contrast' is often used at the beginning of a sentence to introduce a point that is very different from the previous one.
exercises.explain: In contrast 常位于句首，用于引出与前文非常不同的信息。

exercises.q: The previous model required users to press several buttons to complete a task. The new model can be controlled entirely by voice commands. (用 In contrast 合并)
exercises.answer: The previous model required users to press several buttons to complete a task. In contrast, the new model can be controlled entirely by voice commands.
exercises.explain: 旧型号需要按键操作与新型号可用语音控制形成对比，用 In contrast 连接。

exercises.q: The first prototype was heavy and consumed a lot of power. In contrast the final product is lightweight and energy-efficient.
exercises.answer: The first prototype was heavy and consumed a lot of power. In contrast, the final product is lightweight and energy-efficient.
exercises.explain: In contrast 位于句首时后面需要加逗号。

exercises.q: While 4G brought faster mobile Internet to smartphones, 5G, ______, promises to transform entire industries such as healthcare and transportation.
exercises.explain: 4G仅提升手机上网速度与5G变革整个行业形成对比，用 in contrast。

exercises.q: The old manufacturing process required hundreds of workers. ______, the automated system needs only a few technicians to operate.
exercises.explain: 旧流程需要数百工人与自动化系统只需少数技术员形成对比，用 In contrast。

exercises.q: Many traditional classrooms rely heavily on textbooks and lectures. ______, modern classrooms often use interactive digital tools and project-based learning.
exercises.explain: 传统课堂依赖课本与现代课堂使用互动数字工具形成对比，用 In contrast。

exercises.q: The first smartphones were slow and had limited storage. ______, today's devices are powerful enough to run complex applications and store thousands of files.
exercises.explain: 早期智能手机性能弱与如今设备性能强形成对比，用 In contrast。

exercises.q: 4G works for maps. ____, 5G promises gigabit speeds.
exercises.explain: 课文对照。

exercises.q: ____ 5G is faster, coverage may still be weak.
exercises.explain: 让步。

exercises.q: Indoor courts are safe, ____ parks depend on weather.
exercises.explain: 两场所对比。

exercises.q: The outing was cheap. It was, ____, unforgettable.
exercises.explain: 句中插入。

exercises.q: ____ one hand we want speed; on the other we need coverage.
exercises.explain: on the one hand。

exercises.q: Traditional farming depends heavily on weather conditions. ______, modern vertical farming uses controlled environments to grow crops all year round.
exercises.explain: 传统农业依赖天气与现代垂直农业使用受控环境形成对比，用 In contrast。

exercises.q: The first computers filled entire rooms and could only perform simple calculations. ______, today's smartphones are millions of times more powerful and fit in a pocket.
exercises.explain: 早期计算机体积大功能弱与如今智能手机体积小功能强形成对比，用 In contrast。

exercises.q: 'In contrast' and 'Whereas' can both be used to show a difference, but 'Whereas' is usually placed at the beginning of a sentence followed by a comma.
exercises.explain: Whereas 通常用于句中连接两个分句，不是句首加逗号。

exercises.q: Traditional advertising relies on TV and print media to reach customers. Digital advertising uses social media and search engines to target specific audiences. (用 In contrast 改写)
exercises.answer: Traditional advertising relies on TV and print media to reach customers. In contrast, digital advertising uses social media and search engines to target specific audiences.
exercises.explain: 传统广告依赖电视印刷媒体与数字广告使用社交媒体搜索引擎形成对比，用 In contrast。

exercises.q: The old phone only supports 3G. ______, the new model can connect to 5G networks.
exercises.explain: 前后两句是对比关系，用 In contrast 引出差异。

exercises.q: The city center is always busy. ______, the suburbs are quiet and peaceful.
exercises.explain: busy 与 quiet 形成对比，句首用 In contrast 引出差异。

exercises.q: In the sentence 'In contrast, 5G promises gigabit speeds', the phrase 'In contrast' is used to show a similarity between two things.
exercises.explain: In contrast 表示对比差异，不是相似性。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using 'In contrast': The old phone is slow. The new phone is very fast.
exercises.answer: The old phone is slow. In contrast, the new phone is very fast.
exercises.explain: 用 In contrast 连接两个对比的句子，注意句首位置和逗号。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: The weather in spring is warm. In addition, the weather in autumn is cool.
exercises.answer: The weather in spring is warm. In contrast, the weather in autumn is cool.
exercises.explain: 温暖与凉爽是对比关系，应用 In contrast 而非 In addition。

exercises.q: Tom is very tall. ______, his younger brother is quite short.
exercises.explain: tall 和 short 形成鲜明对比，应选 In contrast。

exercises.q: The north of the country is cold and dry. ______, the south is warm and wet.
exercises.explain: 南北气候差异明显，用 In contrast 表示对比。

exercises.q: My sister loves pop music. ______, I prefer classical music.
exercises.explain: 两人音乐喜好不同，用 In contrast 引出对比。

exercises.q: The first movie was exciting. ______, the second one was boring.
exercises.explain: exciting 与 boring 形成对比，选 In contrast。

exercises.q: Rural clinics still wait. ____, downtown cafés advertise 5G.
exercises.explain: 城乡对照。

exercises.q: ____ the average speed rose, valleys remained blank.
exercises.explain: 让步。

exercises.q: Phones are tools you put away, ____ today's devices ask to be checked.
exercises.explain: 新旧对比。

exercises.q: The brochure is fluent; the map, ____, is incomplete.
exercises.explain: 插入转折。

exercises.q: ____ the connected, the unconnected do not appear on page one.
exercises.explain: to + 名词。

exercises.q: Cats are usually independent. ______, dogs often need more attention from their owners.
exercises.explain: 猫和狗的性格差异用 In contrast 引出。

exercises.q: The old road is narrow and dangerous. ______, the new highway is wide and safe.
exercises.explain: 新旧道路特点相反，用 In contrast 表示对比。

exercises.q: The phrase 'In contrast' is usually placed at the beginning of a sentence and followed by a comma.
exercises.explain: In contrast 通常位于句首，后面加逗号。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using 'In contrast': Winter in Beijing is cold. Summer in Beijing is hot.
exercises.answer: Winter in Beijing is cold. In contrast, summer in Beijing is hot.
exercises.explain: 冷热对比，用 In contrast 引出第二句。

exercises.q: Traditional farming depends heavily on weather conditions. ______, modern greenhouse farming allows year-round production.
exercises.explain: 传统农业依赖天气与现代温室农业全年生产形成对比。

exercises.q: The first half of the match was slow and cautious. ______, the second half was fast and aggressive.
exercises.explain: 比赛上下半场风格对比，用 In contrast 引出。

exercises.q: The phrase 'In contrast' can be replaced by 'On the other hand' in most cases without changing the meaning.
exercises.explain: In contrast 和 On the other hand 都表示对比，常可互换。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using 'In contrast': The first experiment produced clear results. The second experiment produced confusing data.
exercises.answer: The first experiment produced clear results. In contrast, the second experiment produced confusing data.
exercises.explain: clear 与 confusing 对比，用 In contrast 连接。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: The first candidate had excellent qualifications. In contrast, the second candidate also had excellent qualifications.

exercises.q: The company's profits increased last year. ______, its main competitor suffered heavy losses.

exercises.q: Some students prefer studying alone in a quiet room. ______, others learn better in group discussions.
exercises.explain: 两种学习偏好形成对比，用 In contrast 引出。

exercises.q: The novel's main character is optimistic and cheerful. ______, the villain is pessimistic and gloomy.
exercises.explain: 主角与反派性格相反，用 In contrast 表示对比。

exercises.q: Urban areas are often crowded and noisy. ______, rural areas offer more space and silence.
exercises.explain: 城乡环境差异明显，用 In contrast 引出对比。

exercises.q: Industrial speed was rare. ____, digital speed is ordinary.
exercises.explain: 时代对照。

exercises.q: ____ slowness has become a luxury, policy still praises speed.

exercises.q: The first page is clean, ____ the footnote is crowded.

exercises.q: The data are true; the story, ____, is selective.
exercises.explain: 插入。

exercises.q: On the one hand we gain alerts; ____ we lose silence.
exercises.explain: 成对另一面。

exercises.q: Many people believe that technology isolates us. ______, others argue that it connects us more than ever before.

exercises.q: The old factory employed hundreds of workers. ______, the new automated plant requires only a few technicians.

exercises.q: In the sentence 'In contrast, the new policy has reduced costs', the phrase 'In contrast' introduces a result of the previous statement.
exercises.explain: In contrast 引出对比信息，不是结果。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using 'In contrast': The previous manager was strict and formal. The new manager is relaxed and friendly.
exercises.answer: The previous manager was strict and formal. In contrast, the new manager is relaxed and friendly.
exercises.explain: 两位经理风格对比，用 In contrast 引出。

exercises.q: Whereas the previous generation of mobile networks focused primarily on voice communication, 5G technology, ______, is designed to support massive data transmission and ultra-low latency.
exercises.explain: 前后两代网络技术目标不同，用 in contrast 表示对比。

exercises.q: The first theory assumes that human behavior is largely determined by genetics. ______, the second theory emphasizes the role of environmental factors.
exercises.explain: 两种理论观点相反，用 In contrast 引出第二种理论。

exercises.q: The phrase 'In contrast' can be used interchangeably with 'However' in all contexts without any change in nuance.
exercises.explain: In contrast 强调对比差异，However 更侧重转折，两者并非完全等同。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using 'In contrast': The first policy led to a significant increase in employment. The second policy resulted in widespread job losses.
exercises.answer: The first policy led to a significant increase in employment. In contrast, the second policy resulted in widespread job losses.
exercises.explain: 两项政策结果相反，用 In contrast 连接。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: The first experiment demonstrated a clear causal relationship. In contrast, the second experiment confirmed the same causal relationship.
exercises.answer: The first experiment demonstrated a clear causal relationship. Similarly, the second experiment confirmed the same causal relationship.
exercises.explain: 两个实验结论一致是相似关系，不能用 In contrast。

exercises.q: The company's traditional business model relied on physical stores. ______, its new strategy prioritizes e-commerce and digital platforms.
exercises.explain: 传统模式与新策略形成对比，用 In contrast 引出。

exercises.q: While the first study emphasized the economic benefits of urbanization, the second study, ______, highlighted its environmental costs.
exercises.explain: 两项研究侧重点相反，用 in contrast 表示对比。

exercises.q: The author's earlier works were characterized by optimism and hope. ______, her later novels reveal a deep sense of disillusionment.
exercises.explain: 早期乐观与后期幻灭形成对比，用 In contrast。

exercises.q: Conventional batteries require several hours to recharge fully. ______, the newly developed graphene batteries can reach full capacity in minutes.
exercises.explain: 传统电池与新型电池充电时间差异巨大，用 In contrast。

exercises.q: Once speed was impressive because it was scarce. ____, it is now so ordinary that slowness is luxury.
exercises.explain: 历史对照。

exercises.q: ____ the syntax is smooth, the contradiction remains.
exercises.explain: 让步。

exercises.q: The connected are invited, ____ the unconnected are unmapped.
exercises.explain: 两种人。

exercises.q: The claim of speed is measured; the claim of a better public life, ____, is not.
exercises.explain: 插入。

exercises.q: ____ a market slogan, a public good would name who is left out.
exercises.explain: to + 名词短语。

exercises.q: The initial draft of the report was vague and poorly organized. ______, the final version was concise and logically structured.
exercises.explain: 初稿与终稿质量对比，用 In contrast 引出。

exercises.q: The first approach to solving the problem proved costly and inefficient. ______, the alternative method was both economical and highly effective.
exercises.explain: 两种方法效果对比，用 In contrast 引出。

exercises.q: When 'In contrast' is placed at the beginning of a sentence, it is typically followed by a comma.
exercises.explain: In contrast 位于句首时通常加逗号，这是标准用法。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using 'In contrast': The original design was complex and difficult to manufacture. The revised design is simple and cost-effective.
exercises.answer: The original design was complex and difficult to manufacture. In contrast, the revised design is simple and cost-effective.
exercises.explain: 原设计与修改后设计对比，用 In contrast 引出。

grammar.key: Present Perfect for Unfinished Time / Experience
grammar.title: 现在完成时：yet / already / ever / never / for / since，兼辨一般过去时
grammar.titleEn: Present perfect vs past simple: yet, already, ever, never, for, since
grammar.usage:
现在完成时由“have/has + 过去分词”构成，核心功能之一是把过去发生的动作或状态与现在联系起来。本讲重点掌握两类高频用法：一是“未完成时间”，即动作从过去持续或延续到现在，常与 yet、already、so far、up to now、recently 等连用，表示“到说话时为止尚未发生或已经发生”；二是“经历”，即谈论某人一生中到目前为止是否有过某种经历，常与 ever、never、before、once、twice 等连用。

肯定句结构为“主语 + have/has + 过去分词”，否定句在 have/has 后加 not，疑问句把 have/has 提到主语前。例如：She has already seen that film. / He hasn't replied yet. / Have you ever tried VR glasses? 注意 have/has 常与主语缩略为 've / 's，否定缩略为 haven't / hasn't。

与一般过去时的对比是高中阶段的重点：一般过去时只陈述过去某一具体时间发生的动作，常与 yesterday、last week、in 2019、two days ago 等明确的过去时间状语连用；而现在完成时强调动作对现在的影响或与现在的联系，不与具体过去时间连用。例如“I lost my key yesterday.”只说明昨天丢了钥匙；“I have lost my key.”则强调现在钥匙仍然找不到。

初中阶段通常只要求掌握 have/has + 过去分词的基本形式以及 yet、ever、never 的简单搭配；高中阶段则进一步要求区分现在完成时与一般过去时、现在完成进行时的语用差异，理解“未完成时间”与“已完成动作”的边界，并能在科技、新闻、议论等书面语体中准确使用 yet to do、have yet to break into 等较正式结构。

易错点一：yet 在否定句和疑问句中通常置于句末，但也可放在否定词之后、过去分词之前，如 have not yet broken into，这种语序更正式，常见于书面语。易错点二：already 多用于肯定句，yet 多用于否定句和疑问句，但在表示“惊讶”的疑问句中也可用 already，如 Have you finished already? 易错点三：have been to 表示“去过某地（已回来）”，have gone to 表示“去了某地（尚未回来）”，两者不可混淆。易错点四：现在完成时不能与 yesterday、last year 等明确的过去时间状语连用，但可与 today、this week、this month 等尚未结束的时间段连用。
forms: 肯定句：主语 + have/has + 过去分词（+ 时间状语）
否定句：主语 + have/has + not + 过去分词（+ yet）
疑问句：Have/Has + 主语 + 过去分词（+ ever/yet）?
have/has + yet + 过去分词（正式书面语序，用于否定句）
have/has + been to + 地点（表示“去过某地”）
have/has + gone to + 地点（表示“去了某地”）
notes: yet 放在否定词后、过去分词前（如 have not yet broken into）是较正式的书面语序，高考阅读和写作中常见，不要误认为语序错误。
ever 多用于疑问句表示“曾经”，never 用于否定句表示“从未”，两者都常与现在完成时搭配谈论人生经历。
have been to 与 have gone to 含义不同：前者表示“去过已回”，后者表示“去了未回”，高考单选和完形填空常考。
现在完成时不能与 yesterday、last night、in 2020 等已结束的过去时间连用，但可与 today、this year、so far 等包含现在的时间段连用。
书面语中 have yet to do 相当于 haven't done yet，但语气更正式，常见于议论文和新闻报道，如 The technology has yet to reach the mass market.
